recipes.name: Tomato Soup
recipes.desc: Velvety tomato soup with a grilled bread soldier for dunking. Grandma Golem's favourite; she rates it 'acceptable', which is her highest score.
steps: Simmer ING_TOMATO, ING_ONION, ING_BROTH and ING_MILK; stir every 5 s.
Toast ING_BREAD_SLICE into a dunking soldier; flip once.
Ladle a bowl of ING_TOMATO soup; lay the ING_BREAD_SLICE soldier across the rim.
cx: The soldier is soggy. He has abandoned his post.
It's red. Fine. But is it RED red?
recipes.look: Deep red soup in a round bowl with a cream swirl and a golden bread soldier across the rim.
recipes.anim: Bread soldier salutes (tilts up) when the bowl lands (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Gentle steam wisps; cream swirl spins slowly.
recipes.mut: Steam Team (`water` parts such as `MUT_019` Fire Hydrant Head) speeds the simmer; Sticky Grip prevents spills on the walk.

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle-ish Soup
recipes.desc: Chicken, carrots, celery and Noodle-ish Noodles, which are legally distinct from noodles in every way except shape, taste and being noodles.
steps: Dice ING_CHICKEN, ING_CARROT, ING_CELERY and ING_ONION.
Simmer ING_CHICKEN, ING_CARROT, ING_CELERY, ING_ONION in ING_BROTH; stir.
Boil ING_EGG_NOODLES separately so they stay -ish.
Bowl: ING_EGG_NOODLES, then ING_CHICKEN soup over the top.
cx: These noodles are too noodle. I ordered noodle-ISH.
My soup didn't hug me back.
recipes.look: Golden broth bowl with orange carrot coins, green celery moons and wavy ribbon noodles.
recipes.anim: A single noodle slurps up out of the bowl on the first spoonful (ANM_043 + prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Cosy steam curls shaped like little hearts.
recipes.mut: `ABL_061` Extra Hands runs the pot and the stove together; Steam Team speeds both boils.

recipes.name: Soupsicle (Frozen Soup)
recipes.desc: Tomato-carrot soup simmered, blended smooth and frozen on a stick. Lick it, bite it, or warm it up and feel like you've wasted everyone's time.
steps: Simmer ING_TOMATO and ING_CARROT in ING_BROTH with ING_MILK.
Blend ING_TOMATO, ING_CARROT and ING_MILK until smooth.
Pour into the stick mould and freeze ING_TOMATO, ING_CARROT, ING_BROTH and ING_MILK (10 s).
Unmould onto a plate and dust with ING_HERBS.
cx: It's melting! Soup is escaping!
Frozen soup? That's just a cold opinion.
recipes.look: Red-orange ice pop on a wooden stick with herb flecks frozen inside, frost sparkles on the surface.
recipes.anim: Customer licks it (ANM_043 lick variant); a drip forms and is caught.
recipes.vfx: Cold frost sparkles and a drip particle after 20 s (cosmetic melt).
recipes.mut: `ABL_067` Freeze Touch skips the freezer; `MUT_125` Penguin Body and `MUT_207` Ice Skates (ice) cut freeze time (Cold Snap).

recipes.name: Alphabet Grumble Soup
recipes.desc: Tomato-vegetable soup with letter pasta that grumbles complaints while it cooks. Read the bowl: it's usually 'HOT' or 'EAT ME' or 'WHY'.
steps: Dice ING_TOMATO, ING_CARROT, ING_CELERY and ING_ONION.
Simmer ING_TOMATO, ING_CARROT, ING_CELERY, ING_ONION in ING_BROTH.
Boil ING_ALPHABET_PASTA; the letters mutter until done.
Bowl: ING_ALPHABET_PASTA, ING_TOMATO soup, ING_CROUTON garnish.
cx: My soup spelled 'MEH'. Was that a review?
There are no vowels in this bowl. I counted.
recipes.look: Red soup bowl with floating letter pasta that arranges into a short random word.
recipes.anim: Letters drift to spell a word from a whitelist (client-side, kid-safe list) while the customer reads it.
recipes.vfx: Tiny speech-bubble 'grumble' particles from the bowl.
recipes.mut: `MUT_016` Owl Head customers read the soup aloud (bark); `MUT_095` Headphone Ears chefs hear the grumble cue louder (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Eyeball Broth
recipes.desc: Clear vegetable broth with noodles, and three gummy eyeballs bobbing on top that blink at the spoon. They're candy. They're watching. They're candy.
steps: Chop ING_SPINACH, ING_MUSHROOM, ING_CARROT and ING_ONION.
Simmer ING_BROTH with ING_SPINACH, ING_MUSHROOM, ING_CARROT and ING_ONION.
Bowl: ING_EGG_NOODLES, ING_BROTH soup, then float ING_GUMMY_EYEBALL ×3 last so they don't melt.
cx: Only three eyes? My broth is half-blind.
One of them winked. I'm flattered and disturbed.
recipes.look: Clear green-gold broth with noodles below and three jelly eyeballs bobbing on top.
recipes.anim: Eyeballs bob and track the spoon (client look-at), blinking every 3 s.
recipes.vfx: Comic 'stare lines' for 1 s on serve.
recipes.mut: `MUT_082` Alien Eye-Stalk Trio customers wave back at the eyeballs (bark); Steam Team on both boils.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Screamer Soup
recipes.desc: Silky whistling-pumpkin soup with a Screaming Cheese swirl that shrieks when stirred. The spookiest comfort food in Morph City.
steps: Cube ING_PUMPKIN (it whistles); crumble ING_SCREAMING_CHEESE (it screams).
Simmer ING_PUMPKIN in ING_BROTH with ING_MILK and ING_CINNAMON.
Blend ING_PUMPKIN and ING_MILK silky smooth.
Bowl of ING_PUMPKIN soup topped with an ING_SCREAMING_CHEESE swirl.
cx: It only screamed once. I paid for a full scream.
Too spooky. Not spooky enough. I can't decide and it's your fault.
recipes.look: Bright orange soup in a mini pumpkin-shaped bowl with a white cheese swirl shaped like an open mouth.
recipes.anim: The cheese swirl 'screams' (mouth shape widens) when the spoon touches it (decal flipbook).
recipes.vfx: Comic 'EEEK!' text and a puff of orange leaves (Reduced Effects: text only).
recipes.mut: `MUT_018` Pumpkin Head customers are delighted/offended in equal measure (bark); Spark Blend speeds the blend.

recipes.name: Swamp Stew
recipes.desc: Burbling green stew of Bog Moss and spinach with potato and carrot, topped with gummy worms and candy Bug Crunch. It's 100 % swamp and 0 % actual swamp.
steps: Chop ING_BOG_MOSS, ING_SPINACH, ING_POTATO and ING_CARROT.
Simmer ING_BOG_MOSS, ING_SPINACH, ING_POTATO and ING_CARROT in ING_BROTH; it burbles.
Blend a ladle of ING_BOG_MOSS and ING_SPINACH back in for swampy texture.
Bowl of ING_BOG_MOSS stew, ING_GUMMY_WORM ×2 wriggling, ING_BUG_CRUNCH sprinkle.
cx: Not swampy enough. Where's the mysterious bubble?
A worm looked at me. A GUMMY worm, sure, but still.
recipes.look: Murky green stew with bubbles, two wriggling gummy worms and crunchy candy beetles on top.
recipes.anim: Bubbles rise and pop in the bowl; gummy worms wriggle on a loop (prop bones).
recipes.vfx: Green bubble particles with comic 'blorp' text.
recipes.mut: `MUT_256` Frog Slime Skin and `MUT_134` Slime Body customers feel at home (bark); plant parts speed the chop (Green Thumb).

recipes.name: Lava Lentil Soup
recipes.desc: Hearty lentils simmered with glowing Lava Sauce, crowned with sautéed Lava Peppers. Warm enough to melt a Yeti-Fish's frown.
steps: Chop ING_LAVA_PEPPER, ING_TOMATO, ING_ONION, ING_GARLIC and ING_CARROT.
Sauté ING_LAVA_PEPPER, ING_ONION and ING_GARLIC; two tosses.
Simmer ING_LENTILS, ING_LAVA_SAUCE, ING_TOMATO and ING_CARROT in ING_BROTH.
Blend part of the ING_TOMATO and ING_CARROT base for body.
Bowl of ING_LENTILS soup topped with sautéed ING_LAVA_PEPPER, ING_ONION and ING_GARLIC.
cx: My eyebrows are fine. That means it isn't hot enough.
Lentils are just beans that gave up. Hot ones, though.
recipes.look: Thick orange-red soup glowing faintly, with a crown of glossy red pepper rings.
recipes.anim: Customer's ears puff cartoon steam after ANM_043; bowl glow pulses.
recipes.vfx: Soft orange PointLight glow and steam puffs (no flames).
recipes.mut: Hot Hands on the sauté; Steam Team on the simmer; `MUT_034` Lava Rock Head customers call it 'mild' (bark).

recipes.name: Bread Bowl in a Bread Bowl
recipes.desc: Cheesy potato chowder served in a bread bowl, which is served in a bigger bread bowl. Finish the soup, eat bowl one, panic, eat bowl two.
steps: Bake both ING_BREAD_BOWL on HIGH until crusty.
Simmer ING_POTATO, ING_ONION, ING_CHEESE and ING_MILK in ING_BROTH; stir.
Big ING_BREAD_BOWL, small ING_BREAD_BOWL nested inside, ING_POTATO chowder, ING_BACON bits.
Put the bread lids on at a jaunty angle.
cx: Two bowls? Where's the third? It's bowls all the way down, right?
I ate the inner bowl first. Now the soup is in the outer bowl. Help.
recipes.look: A large round loaf hollowed into a bowl holding a smaller loaf-bowl full of creamy chowder and bacon bits, two bread lids tilted on top.
recipes.anim: Lids hop off with a 'pop' when served (prop tween); customer peers into nested bowls.
recipes.vfx: Steam escapes in two puffs (one per bowl).
recipes.mut: `ABL_061` Extra Hands bakes and simmers in parallel; Steam Team on the chowder.

recipes.name: Bottomless Soup
recipes.desc: Chicken-vegetable soup built on a Bottomless Broth Cube: the bowl refills itself three times at the table. The fourth time it just burps politely.
steps: Dice ING_CHICKEN, ING_CARROT, ING_CELERY, ING_POTATO and ING_ONION.
Activate the ING_BOTTOMLESS_BROTH cube in the empty pot; stir until it starts refilling.
Add ING_CHICKEN, ING_CARROT, ING_CELERY, ING_POTATO and ING_ONION; simmer and stir.
Chop ING_HERBS fine for the garnish.
Bowl: ING_EGG_NOODLES, ING_BOTTOMLESS_BROTH soup with ING_CHICKEN, ING_HERBS on top.
recipes.sat: Patience refill: while the bowl refills, the customer's wait factor W cannot fall (they're busy eating)
cx: It stopped refilling. Bottomless my foot.
I've been here three hours. The soup won't let me leave.
recipes.look: A deep bowl with a gold-foil cube glinting at the bottom; the level visibly rises again after each spoonful.
recipes.anim: Bowl refill bubble-up (texture + mesh scale) after each ANM_043 loop, three times, then a polite burp puff.
recipes.vfx: Golden shimmer at the bottom of the bowl; comic 'refill!' text ×3.
recipes.mut: Steam Team speeds all three boils; Sticky Grip matters — the bowl is heavy and sloshy. `MUT_066` Vacuum Mouth customers finish it in one go (bark).
